C1.name: Clover Garland Bracelet, Sky Blue
C1.lock: A CLOVER-LINK BRACELET: one single line of about fifteen IDENTICAL small four-petal clovers, linked one after another by a tiny round gold jump ring. Each clover is four ROUND light sky-blue stones in a two-by-two quatrefoil, each stone in its own round gold cup edged with a fine BEADED milgrain rim of tiny gold dots, and ONE tiny clear stone at the very centre where the four petals meet. Along the bracelet every clover sits like a diamond, one petal pointing forward along the line, one back and one to each side, and each gold ring joins the tip of one clover's petal to the tip of the next. One gold lobster clasp at one end; a short gold extender chain with a small round gold tag at the other.
C1.neg: Every clover has exactly four round stones plus the tiny clear centre stone: never five petals, never heart-shaped or pointed petals, never solid gold, enamel or mother-of-pearl clovers. The clovers never touch or fuse into a band: a small gap with one gold ring between each pair. Every petal stone is clear light sky blue as in IMAGE 1, never navy, never teal-green, never opaque turquoise, never mixed with other colours. The beaded rims stay fine gold dots.
C1.scale: Each clover is about 10mm across, the size of a small fingernail; each round stone is about 3.5mm, the size of a peppercorn; the bracelet is a delicate line only 1cm wide and about 19cm long.
C1.wscale: The line is only 1cm wide on the wrist; each clover is the size of a small fingernail, and about four clovers sit across the visible top of the wrist.
C1.place: lying flat on the top face in a relaxed oval, the clasp at the back
C1.macro: a short run of three or four of the sky-blue clovers and the small gold rings joining them
